description: Generate wearable-product imagery from a source person image and target product image.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the wearable product image. The image must be between 300 and 4096 pixels in both width and height. The width-to-height ratio must be between 0.4 and 2.5.

fields.name: targetOriginUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the person or model image.

fields.name: targetMaskUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the black-and-white target wear-area mask. Required because this API accepts custom target images rather than saved upstream materials.

fields.name: productCategory
fields.description: Product category. Supported values: footwear (shoes), luggage (bags), eyewear (glasses), necklace, hat, earring, ring, wristband, watch, headwear, belt, other.

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.
